verdicts.finding: The qualified extractor candidate and Page 220 unit hashes match. The Article 26(9) hand-off to a GDPR Article 35 or Directive (EU) 2016/680 Article 27 assessment is supported, but it remains conditional and does not itself create a universal DPIA or FRIA trigger. The Article 113 route must be retained when used for current AI Act applicability.

The Page 224 base candidate is supported as historical base text, but SRC-0043 Page 20 replaces Article 27(4) and (5). It cannot support current binding wording or a current FRIA/DPIA coordination rule.

The Page 20 unit and hashes support the amended Article 27(4) option to cross-reference relevant DPIA sections or include relevant parts in the FRIA when obligations are already met through the specified data-protection assessment. The candidate is binding amending-act evidence, subject to the Article 113 application route.

The Page 20 unit and hashes support the amended Article 27(5) AI Office questionnaire-template mandate and the possibility of DPIA cross-references or included relevant parts where relevant. The candidate is binding amending-act evidence, subject to the Article 113 application route.

The Page 35 unit and hashes support route-dependent application dates for Chapter III Sections 1, 2 and 3: 2 December 2027 for Article 6(2)/Annex III high-risk systems and 2 August 2028 for Article 6(1)/Annex I high-risk systems, subject to the recorded Article 6(5) exception. This is not a universal Article 27 date.
